01 The builder's foundation

TWO YEARS.
LIMITED BUDGET.
REAL SYSTEMS.

MerQato has been built through experimentation, working software, free models, existing hardware, and hands-on self-hosting—not through an oversized technical team or an unlimited budget.

Local AI

Ollama & Qwen

Run smaller local models for tedious work, testing and routine tasks where practical. Keep sensitive information local when the workflow permits.

Agent Work

Hermes / OpenCode / Maus

Explore orchestrated agents, development assistants, automation workflows, and repeatable processes that reduce manual workload.

Production Operations

Coolify & UpCloud

Deploy live applications, manage servers, maintain databases, and coordinate services remotely—even when the laptop is switched off.

This investment is intended to turn accumulated technical capability into repeatable client outcomes, recurring revenue and transferable intellectual property.

04 Model routing & savings

THE RIGHT AI.
FOR THE RIGHT JOB.

The smallest suitable tool performs routine tasks. Stronger cloud models handle complex work. We avoid paying frontier-model prices for predictable jobs.

Tier 01 · Cheapest

Scripts & Local Models

Monitoring, batch scripts, simple classification, Ollama, small Qwen models and low-risk repetition.

Tier 02 · Usage based

DeepSeek & APIs

Extraction, summaries, reasoning, document operations, moderate programming and production agent workflows.

Tier 03 · Selectively

Codex & Claude

Demanding software architecture, complex debugging, difficult reasoning, major production changes and independent reviews.

AI systems must be subject to cost limits, tests, careful permissions and human approval for sensitive actions. Cloud API charges are separate from consumer subscriptions.

09 Privacy-first by design

CLIENT DATA
IS NOT AN
AFTERTHOUGHT.

Trust is a product feature. We minimize external data exposure, maintain separate customer access and use local AI processing where it is appropriate and reliable.

Protect data

Encrypted connections, scoped credentials, tenant isolation, backups, defined retention policies and careful handling of personal information.

Control the agents

Least-privilege permissions, spending limits, audit logs and human approval for sensitive, costly or irreversible actions.

Local inference can reduce third-party exposure, but it does not by itself guarantee privacy or security. Real protection also requires good engineering and operations.

11 Cloud compute vs local hardware

RENT FIRST.
BUY WHEN JUSTIFIED.

UpCloud coordinates 24/7 services. DeepSeek and stronger cloud models run only when called. Specialized GPU instances can be rented for model experiments. Local hardware becomes an investment milestone after measuring demand.

ScenarioPlanning budgetBest use
Cloud-first₱0 hardwareExisting VPS, APIs and optional rented GPUs
32GB mini PC₱30,000–₱45,000Local lightweight inference, continuous CPU workloads
64GB upgradeable mini PC₱45,000–₱75,000More parallel local workloads and selected larger models
Heavy AI workstationQuotation requiredFrequent sustained inference that justifies dedicated hardware

Compact systems from GMKtec or Minisforum are candidates, not preselected purchases. GPU speed, memory bandwidth, reliability and electricity cost matter alongside RAM.

14 Partner safeguards and terms

DISCIPLINE.
OWNERSHIP.
ACCOUNTABILITY.

Financial controls and spending approval

Set monthly subscription limits, budget and monitor API tokens, require approval before hardware or VPS expansion, report actual expenses, revenue, receivables and runway.

Privacy, client separation and software rights

Implement appropriate safeguards for private information, client access isolation, source-code ownership and licensing compliance. No accidental sharing of credentials or client data with agents.

Partner visibility and participation

Maintain a shared operational dashboard for progress, financial information and approvals. Assign the partner learning and smaller projects with appropriate permissions and review.

Investment terms and potential exit

Agree on whether investment is equity or debt, amounts, distributions, decision rights, IP ownership, vesting if relevant, and exit provisions. A future sale or investor return is not guaranteed.
